content: Sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim, marketed under the brand name Bactrim, is a synthetic antibacterial combination medication. It is available in two formulations for oral administration: double strength (DS) tablets containing 800 mg of sulfamethoxazole and 160 mg of trimethoprim, and standard tablets containing 400 mg of sulfamethoxazole and 80 mg of trimethoprim. Sulfamethoxazole is chemically identified as N1-(5-methyl-3-isoxazolyl)sulfanilamide, with the molecular formula C10H11N3O3S. Its structural formula is provided in the documentation. Trimethoprim is chemically identified as 2,4-diamino-5-(3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl)pyrimidine, with the molecular formula C14H18N4O3. Its structural formula is also provided in the documentation. The inactive ingredients in the formulation include docusate sodium (85%), sodium benzoate (15%), sodium starch glycolate, magnesium stearate, and pregelatinized starch.
